I told Pree in our DM that her cutoff for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork is 21 October. I took that from her own 14 October message in the same DM.

gbrain wouldn't let me read back the note I saved. It refused the lookup because its access token isn't tied to any member, so it can't tell whose private facts it may return. That didn't change the answer, but I can't get saved per-member notes back until it's fixed. The fix has to be done by an admin on the gbrain server (gbrain auth rescope with --member, or --may-act-for for a shared bot).
